scope: Actual MCP transport, Rust-game analysis capability, concurrent access and persistence. Not full-game reconstruction acceptance.
result: validated critical paths with repaired configuration and documented limits

providers.name: ghidra
providers.proof: Three ClientSessions,45 game-function reads, byte and reference identity, PID-pinned default routing with multiple simultaneous backends; two same-function writers use separate clones, save and restart preserve distinct parameters.
providers.limitations: Worker overlay merges require review; parallel submissions do not establish a speed multiplier.

providers.name: reva
providers.proof: Fixed Python dependencies and built Java extension. Four clients decompile; three simultaneous scripts have isolated stdout. Signatures and P-code recovered, saved and reopened. Compact worker gateway positive script/lifecycle and negative script error detection passed.
providers.limitations: get-functions builds global cache and took107.7s, excluded. Incoming-reference context disabled by default. Shared read6, script/write worker10; script integer-to-Java-int overload must not truncate64-bit addresses.

providers.name: re-mcp
providers.verdict: retain on demand, multi-database worker pool
providers.proof: Two 131517-function existingB clones reused without reanalysis. Two proxy clients share daemon and26 calls passed; same-address comments isolated and durable after manual/automatic save/reopen.
providers.limitations: Stock3.0.3 save fails with project-owned transaction; local patch uses GhidraProject.save. Each worker serializes APIs; different workers can progress concurrently. One SDK teardown race preserved; final message barrier passed retest. Mac state uses Library/Application Support, ignoresXDG_STATE_HOME.

providers.name: rea
providers.verdict: retain on demand, independent native oracle
providers.proof: Original B identity plus real20-byte aspect machine code in explicitPE fixture; decompilation/P-code and second-target sameVA isolation passed in independent concurrentstdio clients.
providers.limitations: Ephemeral project, no retainedGhidra project reuse; around93s cold startup in fixture test. No full B autoanalysis was rerun. Full139 tool catalog not default-exposed.

providers.name: radare2
providers.verdict: retain on demand, original bytes/disassembly and independent decompiler
providers.proof: Restored installation and missingpdg plugin. OriginalB reads, local functions, nonemptycalls andtwo-client target isolation passed.
providers.limitations: DefaultMCP sandbox and actualTPI parser limitations are distinct. PDB publics work in CLI but fullMCP publics/types import was not established; LLVM remains metadata source.

source_preservation: Original releaseB byte identity and original Ghidra source content/mtime preserved in provider reports. No game execution or business Rust edits.
registered_catalog_note: SDK operator usable by current agents; native MCP catalog requires reconnect/new session for updated registrations.
integration_policy: Shared read only. Each modifying agent chooses unique --worker and --write; database and named script files isolated. Never merge entire databases wholesale.
